def state(message,**kw):

def finishcron():
 tag='# ontrack-one-shot-full-backup'
 p=subprocess.run(['crontab','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
 if p.returncode==0 and tag in p.stdout:
  content='\n'.join(s for s in p.stdout.splitlines() if tag not in s)+'\n'
  subprocess.run(['crontab','-'],input=content,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
try:
 state('running')
 db=home/'.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite'
 sqliteok=False
 if db.is_file():
  source=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(db)+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=10)
  target=sqlite3.connect(str(dest/'sqlite-consistent-copy.db'),timeout=10)
  with target:source.backup(target,pages=128,sleep=.05)
  integrity=target.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
  source.close();target.close()
  if integrity!='ok':raise RuntimeError('sqlite_integrity_failed')
  (dest/'sqlite-consistent-copy.db').chmod(0o600)

 # Archive the owner account excluding the newly created backup directory;
 # never follow symlinks or alter the source tree.
 members=[p.name for p in home.iterdir() if p.name!='backup']
 archive=dest/'account-files.tar.gz'
 cmd=['tar','--warning=no-file-changed','-czf',str(archive),'--directory',str(home),'--exclude=./backup','--']+members
 env=os.environ.copy();env['GZIP']='-1'
 with open(dest/'tar-status.log','w') as log:
  proc=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=1700)
 if proc.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('archive_exit_'+str(proc.returncode))
 archive.chmod(0o600)
 sha=hashlib.sha256()
 with archive.open('rb') as f:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(4*1024*1024),b''):sha.update(chunk)
 verify=subprocess.run(['tar','-tzf',str(archive)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=1200)
 if verify.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('backup_archive_verify_failed')
 state('success',archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,archive_sha256=sha.hexdigest(),sqlite_integrity='ok' if sqliteok else 'not_present',source_items=len(members),outside_webroot=True)
except Exception as e:
 state('failed',reason=type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:100])
finally:finishcron()
'''
